goal: Prove exact measurable-event total-variation contraction under an actual common Markov kernel, supporting companion-paper composition.
source_anchor: SPHMC arXiv:2609.06906v1 Section 7.2 input/proxy error transfer; PBPS arXiv:2609.06905v1 Section 4.3 costs remain separate.
theorem_delta: For probability measures μ and ν and Markov kernel K, an eventwise bound |μ(s)-ν(s)|≤δ for every measurable s implies the same δ bound for every measurable event of K∘μ and K∘ν. All measurability and integrability are proved from the kernel and probability hypotheses.
truth_boundary: No construction of the PBPS algorithm kernel, warm proxy, invariance, convergence or expected query-cost bound. TV proximity does not transfer unbounded expected cost.
